import pandas as pd
def leak_test(features,s,t):
    before=features(s).loc[t]
    changed=set()
    for sign in (-1,1):
        v=s.astype(float).copy()
        mask=v.index>=t
        offsets=pd.Series(range(1, int(mask.sum())+1),index=v.index[mask])
        v.loc[mask]+=sign*(1000*offsets)
        after=features(v).loc[t]
        moved=after.ne(before) & ~(before.isna() & after.isna())
        changed.update(before.index[moved])
    return sorted(changed)
